title: Industry bilingual documentation audit: complete canonical defect inventory
language: English analysis; exact original Korean/English quotations are intentionally preserved.
deduplication_rule: Merge Korean/English occurrences sharing an IND-nnn-nn ID only. Related defects across documents are grouped into root issue families without dropping distinct cases, source locations or evidence. 283 is not a claim of 283 unrelated root causes.
publication_scope: Prepared for Main to copy under integration/audits/2026-09-19/. No source edits or external publication performed by this reviewer.
explicit_unknowns: Real customer participation, access to private member/transaction/logistics data, live integrations and deployment are unverified unless an individual public source specifically establishes them.
Benchmark, A/B, causal-effect, prediction, monthly cost, capacity and delivery-time claims need their stated datasets, methods and assumptions; synthetic examples are not measured results.
Exact service/product/version/region/account eligibility and OpenSearch Serverless pipeline/analyzer combinations remain configuration-specific; public feature existence is not runtime validation.
Some official business/member/brand information is historical. In particular, a transaction announcement does not establish current completed ownership.
Tourist VAT refund source versions contain differing historical details; no claim is made that all current limits or transaction-specific eligibility were verified.
Unidentified competitor names, unverified source rating fields, missing public dataset access contracts and unsupported official tier/benefit assumptions remain unresolved.

occurrences.original_heading: ### 4.1 S9-A — Five-level Downline tree for a Diamond-level ABO
occurrences.original_quotation:
MATCH (root:ABO {level: 'Diamond', abo_id: $rootId})
CALL {
  WITH root
  MATCH path = (root)-[:HAS_DOWNLINE*1..5]->(d:ABO)
  RETURN d, length(path) AS depth
}
RETURN d.abo_id, d.level, d.pv, d.bv, depth
ORDER BY depth, d.pv DESC

## 5. Churn Signatures (z-score based)

| Signature | Definition |
|---|---|
| Repeated payment failures | At least 2 of the last 3 auto-payments fail |
| Zero activity | No activity for 30 days while auto-renewal is imminent |
| Downline drop-off (ABO) | Sponsor has at least one Downline cancel |
| Surge within 24 hours of price increase | Cancel-event spike after the price-increase announcement |
| Seasonal effect | Avoidance of end-of-quarter renewals |

| 시그너처 | 정의 |
|---|---|

| 활동 0 | 30일 활동 없음 + 구독 자동 갱신 임박 |
| Downline 이탈 (ABO) | Sponsor의 Downline 1명 이상 해지 |

issue_groups.title: Public PoC, customer and execution status
issue_groups.correction_principle: Identify public-information proposals, synthetic UI mockups, cached demonstrations and verified implementations separately.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Publicly releasable customer authorization, actual data/connection provenance, reproducible artifacts and dated execution evidence; otherwise publish only a proposed/illustrative status.

issue_groups.title: Server authorization, consent and identity boundaries
issue_groups.correction_principle: Enforce authenticated object/row/tool permissions and valid purpose/channel consent before data access or action; presentation personas and content filters are separate.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Server authorization/consent contracts, missing-value handling and scoped allow/deny tests; no UI-only enforcement claim.

issue_groups.title: Guardrails product scope and application controls
issue_groups.correction_principle: Separate documented content filters, denied topics and sensitive-information checks from business authorization, generation, consent and regulatory judgment.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Versioned public product capabilities and concrete application integration; no universal misinformation, masking or compliance guarantee.

issue_groups.title: Jurisdiction-specific legal and policy claims
issue_groups.correction_principle: Identify jurisdiction, transaction/product, effective date, scope and exceptions; distinguish legal duties, voluntary codes and application policy.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Public primary law/regulator/policy text and qualified scope review; uncertain legal conclusions remain unresolved.

issue_groups.title: Company identity, ownership, brand and dated business facts
issue_groups.correction_principle: Use precise legal entities, ownership versus partnership/distribution, historical dates and defined population/store units.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Dated public corporate filings, official brand/member policies or company releases; unknown identities must not be guessed.

issue_groups.title: Product/API availability and compatibility
issue_groups.correction_principle: Specify exact product, version, region, eligibility and supported API fields; a similar product name is not a drop-in replacement.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Retrieved official service/API/version support and a coherent architecture contract; runtime success remains unverified.

issue_groups.title: Graph, query and event schema contracts
issue_groups.correction_principle: Align node/edge names, direction, hop depth, properties and event/time identities across diagrams, ontology, generators and queries.
issue_groups.publication_gate: A single explicit supported schema and query contract with testable fixtures; do not treat missing fields or joins as inferred data.

issue_groups.title: Executable query syntax, cardinality and aggregation
issue_groups.correction_principle: Use supported syntax and preserve event/order/line identity; prevent Cartesian multiplication and define filter/limit/aggregation scope.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Version-specific engine support plus representative offline or authorized execution fixtures before claiming a runnable result.

issue_groups.title: Metric definitions, units, denominators and direction
issue_groups.correction_principle: Define observation unit, numerator/denominator, period, aggregation, percent versus percentage points and historical versus predictive meaning.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Explicit formulas and data contracts with reproducible calculations; unexplained numbers remain illustrative.

issue_groups.title: Statistical models, calibrated scores and predictions
issue_groups.correction_principle: Specify inputs, likelihood/response model, fitting and evaluation; do not equate clustering scores, entropy or R-squared with calibrated confidence or causal evidence.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Data/model specification, validation split, diagnostics, uncertainty and calibration; unsupported model results remain examples.

issue_groups.title: Correlation, attribution and causal claims
issue_groups.correction_principle: Separate contemporaneous association, attribution rules and scenario simulation from identified incremental effects.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Causal estimand, graph/identification assumptions, comparison design/confounding controls and publicly shareable validation; otherwise describe association only.

issue_groups.title: Data access, provenance, cohort and individual linkage
issue_groups.correction_principle: Distinguish proposed counts, public aggregates, synthetic fixtures and authorized individual records; aggregate signals do not establish a person's behavior.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Source/access/license, stable permitted identifiers, grain/cohort, collection and join contracts; no real-data or individual-linkage claim without evidence.

issue_groups.title: Temporal alignment, refresh and fallback state
issue_groups.correction_principle: Preserve source frequency, publication lag, timezone, units and event timestamps; label cache/fallback freshness explicitly.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Versioned source fields/frequency, join/window rules, missing-data treatment and as-of markers.

issue_groups.title: Performance, cost, capacity and quantitative outcome evidence
issue_groups.correction_principle: Separate conditional arithmetic/estimates from measured results; specify workload, dimensions, region/date and complete cost/benchmark scope.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Dated primary prices or original measurements, assumptions, formulas, denominator and comparable baseline; unsupported values remain unverified.

issue_groups.title: Delivery schedule and prerequisite ordering
issue_groups.correction_principle: Present scope/team/data-access-dependent estimates; protect real data before demonstrations and reconcile stated durations with the agenda.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Dependencies, approval/access gates, staffing, complete scope and measured/reviewed schedule assumptions.

issue_groups.title: Cross-document contracts, counts and presentation consistency
issue_groups.correction_principle: Keep scenario/tool/data counts and shared contracts consistent across source documents and locale versions.
issue_groups.publication_gate: One authoritative shared inventory and a checked mapping of every affected document; label deliberate alternatives.

issue_groups.title: Read, recommend and execute boundaries
issue_groups.correction_principle: Distinguish inspection, prediction, recommendation, cache refresh and externally visible actions; define approval and failure behavior.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Explicit tool inputs/outputs, authenticated permissions, side effects, approval, timeouts and recovery contracts.

issue_groups.title: Component responsibilities and data flow
issue_groups.correction_principle: Separate authentication/token validation, model/tool calls, graph/index flows and refresh/orchestration responsibilities.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Coherent request/data flow and integration contract; diagrams must not imply missing components or integrations.

issue_groups.title: Locale identity, meaning and formatting
issue_groups.correction_principle: Preserve legal/entity/brand/test-input meaning across Korean and English; repair literal formatting without changing the intended scenario.
issue_groups.publication_gate: Exact counterpart passages and official entity/brand naming where relevant; unresolved translation identity stays explicit.
